name: John Hickenlooper
role: U.S. senator from Colorado; governor (2011–2019) and Denver mayor (2003–2011)
summary: Hickenlooper supports universal healthcare through mixed provision, stronger worker protections, civil rights and public investment. His climate policy combines major clean-energy measures with an earlier record of support for regulated fracking.
